Message Types

e Credit Worthiness Change Information

Notes on SAP Implementation

The CA-SOA-ESM-ERP-FIN component and the CREDAGYO06 business process are used to facilitate forward error handling.

After the inbound proxy is processed, a trigger is created to change the relevant Contract Accounting master data. This trigger is
created once the changes have been made to the associated Credit Management master data. The changes made to the Contract
Accounting master data are used in mass activity transaction FPBPCU in the Contract Accounting system.You can use the
Financial Accounting (FI-CA) event 4603 to create your own triggers for master data change

Check Benefit Free Period

Definition

To determine whether benefit exemption exists for an insurance policy for a claim period, due to payments that have not been
made.

Technical Data

Entity Type                                        Service Operation

Release State                                     released

Technical Name                                InsuranceContractBenefitFreePeriodBylnsuranceContractIDAndClaimPeriodQueryResponse_In
Namespace                                       http://sap.com/xi/FS-CD/Global ri
Application Component                        FS-CD

Web Service Definition (Back End)          INSURANCECONTRACTBENEFITFREEPE
Category                                           SAP A2A

Direction                                               inbound

Mode                                                   synchronous

Idempotency                                         no

Change/Update Behavior                      not applicable

P2P Communication Enabled                 true

Business Context and Use
